backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining story, comment, review, and user profile types with access control, persistent maps, and user/admin operations for submitting and managing stories.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing authentication and admin‑workflow features with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend components, pages, hooks, and configuration files for reference.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining IC canister structure, usage of frontend vs backend canister IDs, and basic deployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens and themes for light and dark mode.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app with favicon and Apple touch icon metadata.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router configuration defining all app routes and wrapping them with the shared layout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component that displays access-denied messaging, login prompts, and navigation options based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with navigation, auth handling, and conditional admin link using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer with navigation links and contact info.
Form component to submit a new comment for a story using useAddComment.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays comments for a story with loading skeletons and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Shows discussion thread comments for a story using global discussions data.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Diagnostic panel showing canister IDs and raw URL with copy-to-clipboard actions.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Form for submitting a star rating and optional review for a story using useAddReview.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Displays story reviews, loading skeletons, and empty states using fetched discussions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides admin checks and mutations for approving, publishing, creating, and deleting stories.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Checks backend heartbeat availability and reports reachability state.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Fetches all discussions and provides a mutation for adding reviews.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity login, state management, and exposing identity context to the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Provides hooks for fetching stories, comments, submissions, and submitting content with retry logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind styles and custom light/dark blue theme variables with typography and layout rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static about page displaying author bio, platform purpose, and contact email.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Admin interface for reviewing pending stories, publishing or creating articles, and deleting published content.
frontend/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx: Shows a single published article with metadata, full content, and its comment section.
frontend/src/pages/ArticlesPage.tsx: Lists all published articles with loading and error states and links to article detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page featuring author details, book info, email link, and social media buttons.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays discussion threads by topic with tabs for comments and reviews and supports topic selection.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the list of published stories, handles loading and error states, and shows backend availability diagnostics with retry options.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero content and navigation buttons for reading, submitting, and logging in, plus feature descriptions.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Manages Internet Identity login/logout flow and displays authenticated user info or login prompts.
frontend/src/pages/MySubmissionsPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for a user submissions page.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Shows a single story with metadata, handles loading/errors, and includes comment composer and thread components.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Form for authenticated users to submit a story with optional anonymity, showing login prompts or success messages as needed.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: React page showing canister‑resolution troubleshooting info, warnings, and copyable canister URLs using data from getCanisterInfo().
frontend/src/utils/authErrors.ts: Provides helpers to detect unauthorized errors and extract readable error messages.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Utilities to detect frontend/backend canister IDs from hostname or env and generate standard/raw IC URLs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from hashes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Project state file outlining current features, issues, and requirements for login visibility and admin moderation workflow.
